items.source_ref: Main Eq. (1), PDF p. 3
items.scientific_object: The printed nearest-neighbour XY Hamiltonian is Hermitian under the stated ladder-operator convention
items.authored_reason: The literal printed operator is non-Hermitian while the conjugate-corrected XY exchange is Hermitian; this is registered as a paper-error candidate pending fresh independent adjudication.

items.source_ref: Main Eqs. (2)-(9) and Supplement Sec. 5, PDF pp. 3-4 and 14-15
items.scientific_object: The zig-zag Hamiltonian realizes perfect state transfer for every allowed integer m
items.authored_reason: A frozen finite-domain counterexample search supports the spectrum and transfer property, but it does not replace an analytic proof for every integer m.

items.source_ref: Main Eqs. (10)-(11) and Supplement Sec. 5, PDF pp. 4 and 15
items.scientific_object: Eliminating even sites at large m yields the stated half-length PST chain
items.authored_reason: Independent Schur-complement calculations show the low-energy spectrum converging to the printed half-chain limit as m increases.

items.source_ref: Main Eq. (12), Fig. 3 discussion and Supplement Sec. 4, PDF pp. 5 and 12-13
items.scientific_object: The isospectral FST deformation produces the claimed remote Bell state with a declared phase gauge
items.authored_reason: The deformation is isospectral and produces equal endpoint support; a declared local phase flip reconciles the generated Bell-plus convention with the named Bell-minus state.
